description: OPM publishes open reservoir benchmark input decks for comparing simulators and numerical methods. The collection includes full and reduced Norne cases and several SPE comparative-solution benchmarks with different flow and grid challenges. The provider is Open Porous Media Initiative. Coverage: The collection mixes a Norwegian Sea field model with synthetic benchmarks. Each case has its own grid and simulation schedule, not a common observation period. Access: The provider describes the opm-data repository and the available cases. No decks or archives were downloaded. Licence and cost: The OPM page specifies the Open Database License. Per-case and database-content notices should be retained when obtaining the decks. Limitations: Cases exercise different simulator features and have different realism and complexity. A benchmark match does not establish validity for an untested reservoir. For simulation it supplies reusable reservoir test cases and regression inputs. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
